claim: The piezo controller generates high voltages to drive the piezo actuators and relies on a protective earth, provided through its approved external power supply, to keep accessible parts safe if insulation fails. Only approved stages and cables may be used with it, and it must not be used if it shows any damage or seems faulty.
validity_conditions: Read from NPC-D Series Digital Controller Interface Library manual, revision 6.0, for DLL 2.7.9 (sha256 88da6849...): printed page 2 (PDF page 2). Also NanoFlash Reflash Application User Manual (sha256 98fbdbf6...): printed page 2 (PDF page 2). Also Nanobench 6000 Customer Interface Software User Manual, PS-000006-UM issue 4 / v1.0.19 (sha256 2acb47b5...): printed page 5 (PDF page 5). E3 vendor_spec: the manufacturer's statement, not an observation on this bench. These manuals are for the controller's software; the archive holds no hardware manual for the stage or the controller. The NanoBench manual confirms the controller contains a high-voltage amplifier driving the actuator. KNOWLEDGE, NOT POLICY: this is what the manufacturer says. What any session may do, and every limit anyone here acts on, is the person's, written into the envelope after confirming it on the instrument.
